caption: The drawing depicts an upright piano, primarily brown in color, with a wood grain texture evident throughout the body, legs, and frame. The piano features elaborately curved legs and a rectangular structure. The upper panel above the keyboard is filled with a red background radiating lines outward from a central, round, golden decorative element. The keyboard has a standard arrangement of white and black keys, and directly above it there’s a gold decorative filigree pattern stretching across the width, with a round emblem at its center. The lower section of the piano has two cabinet doors, each with a central knob. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige. The artist’s name, “Lorenz Rothkranz,” is printed in the lower right corner.
title: Piano
